cohort: The cohort consisted of 138 pathologically confirmed Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) patients and 276 age-matched controls from an academic women's hospital in China.
finding: Placenta previa, increased gravidity, and increased parity were identified as independent risk factors for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), which in turn significantly increased rates of maternal (postpartum hemorrhage, hysterectomy) and neonatal (perinatal mortality, preterm birth, low birth weight, asphyxia) complications.
mod_finding: PAS patients had significantly higher rates of cesarean section, and specific PAS grades (3D/3E) were associated with higher cesarean rates.
